readme:
# RafzHost — Lightweight Ubuntu SSH for Railway

Minimal Ubuntu 24.04 SSH server. Super light & fast deploy.

## Quick Deploy
1. Set **ROOT_PASSWORD** (required)
2. Railway opens TCP proxy on port 22
3. Connect:
```bash
ssh root@<your-domain> -p <port>
```

## Variables
- `ROOT_PASSWORD` (required) — root password
- `HOSTNAME` (optional) — custom hostname
- `SSH_USERNAME` + `SSH_PASSWORD` (optional) — secondary user
- `AUTHORIZED_KEYS` (optional) — SSH public keys for root

Telegram: t.me/Rafzbotz · t.me/RafzHost

© RafzHost

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Mandatory root password. Container will not start without it.

HOSTNAME.description: Optional custom hostname for the container.

SSH_USERNAME.description: Optional secondary user (set together with SSH_PASSWORD).

SSH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the optional secondary user.

AUTHORIZED_KEYS.description: SSH public key(s) for root key-based login.
